page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware, which limits its utility for accelerated graphics or hardware-dependent machine learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr7.24xlarge offers a high density of dedicated high-frequency CPU cores and memory resources, making it suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The absence of local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff that optimizes the instance for workloads relying on external storage arrays. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
